name: Girl Scout Summer Day Camp (GSEMA)
description_short: Girl Scouts of Eastern Massachusetts runs five day camps for girls entering grades K-12: Cedar Hill (Waltham), Favorite (Brewster), Maude Eaton (Andover), Rice Moody (Reading) and Wind in the Pines (Plymouth). Camp runs 9 AM-4 PM, and round-trip bus transportation is included in the fee.
swim_waterfront_notes: Varies by camp: pools at Cedar Hill and Rice Moody (canoeing on the pond at Cedar Hill for some units); swimming in Pomps Pond at Maude Eaton; Gallows Pond at Wind in the Pines; swimming and boating at Favorite.
